outcome.summary: Partial, restricted results only; whether a balanced 9-variable function with nonlinearity ≥242 exists remains open. Proven by an elementary degree/Parseval argument, without the unrefereed RM(1,9) preprint: the maximum balanced nonlinearity on 9 variables is 240 or 242, every balanced function of degree ≤7 has nonlinearity ≤240 (attained by x0+x1x2+x3x4+x5x6+x7x8), and any balanced NL-242 function has degree exactly 8 and nonzero support XOR. Exhaustive computations with import-free independent checkers show that no balanced NL≥242 function lies within Hamming distance 6, after any affine output addition, of five explicit Kavut–Yücel NL-242 tables. These tables are pairwise EA-inequivalent by absolute indicators 40/32/56/48/64. Exact balanced maximum 240, each with an in-class attainer, h
